text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(At the edge of my vision—a burst of light 
flashed.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(A single streak of flash. Seeing that, 
I...)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: —Kh!? Damn—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... I couldn't 
reachâ...!

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text:
You did great out there, Fenomeno!! It was 
so close! I'll be cheering for you next 
time too!

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text: Fenomeno! You were so cool!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —...Everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—To think you possess such a voracious 
hunger, even though you are still only in 
the Classic class.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Flash-san...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Your presence caught me completely by 
surprise."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It was a terrifying run. Once she locked 
onto her target, she never eased up... 
Chasing, passing, aiming straight for the 
lead.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
A strength born of blending diligence with 
boldness. I truly envy you... for 
possessing that ability to "lock on."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you so very much for the kind 
words!!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Boss! Did you hear?!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Flash-san acknowledged me! She said I have 
wonderful power!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I had it in me too. A strength all my own, 
capable of stirring someone's heart!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"This strength will surely serve as my 
guidepost! Let's train hard so it becomes 
even greater combat power!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno happily gives her report, as if 
she had just found treasure for the very 
first time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—As a Trainer, I have to nurture this 
joy.”

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Just as Flash-san took notice of! I won't 
let any opponent or opportunity slip away! 
I'll lock on and—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I'll runnn!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: (If I polish this power——)

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: (Even "I"—can captivate hearts!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Boss. For my next race, I request to enter 
the Japan Cup!!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—Because Orfevre-san, the strongest active 
Umamusume, will also be running in that 
race.
choice_data_list:
It's finally time for a direct 
showdown...!

It's finally time for a direct 
showdown...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Orfevre. The Umamusume who, more than 
anyone else in Japan recently, let us 
dream of winning the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And no matter when, they are the one and 
only presence who captures the hearts of 
children and adults alike and never lets 
go."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
It remains deeply engraved in my heart 
even now. ...The day when the children's 
admiration was completely captivated by 
her.
choice_data_list:
That was the day you worried about the end 
of the century, wasn't it?

That was the day you lamented the end of 
the century, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I have always thought so. That 
someday, I must surpass her.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
The time is now! With the strength I 
gained at the Autumn Tenno Sho! And by 
demonstrating the weapon I honed in 
training, combined with a spoonful of good 
luck—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
We should be able to reach a chance to 
surpass her!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Fenomeno's next goal was set for 
the Japan Cup.
